note: Switch "council" (off by default): the men at your table argue over what you do. Each seat is filled by the first man on its list who is free in the city and not your open enemy, or by the man you seat there. Each gives counsel from his faction, his traits, his ambition and what he knows. A man who plots against you, wants your place or hates you gives counsel that serves himself, and can lie. The idea comes from King of Dragon Pass and Suzerain (docs/game-research.md, proposal 4); the war council of about 404 BC in Diodorus 14.8.5 is the model scene (docs/research/council-and-secrets.md). Rules and lines are invention.
